dropna_policy: Exact ta.utils.dropna on these six Freqtrade-shaped columns; native ignore=0 is NOT passed to dropna; any removed valid input row is separately reported

execution_if_gate_passes.benchmark: buy first executable evaluation open; liquidate final evaluation close under each same fee/slippage scenario; blocked together with strategy if causality gate fails
execution_if_gate_passes.execution_clock: closed 12h signal to next 12h open; extra sensitivity waits one further complete 12h bar; no same-bar signal fill
execution_if_gate_passes.exit_priority: At executable open: stop-gap, explicit prior-close exit signal, ROI; within-bar conservative low-before-high ordering: pre-existing stop first, then ROI, then trailing update for next bar only. No claim of original Freqtrade intrabar engine equivalence.
execution_if_gate_passes.outage: 2023-03-24 11:27 until 14:00 UTC official suspension; reject scheduled 12:00 order at fake time; defer that bar-open order to 14:00, use native 12h bar open only as first observed post-resumption price proxy, explicitly timestamp 14:00; if first-open alignment to reviewed native1h14:00 fails, execution blocked
execution_if_gate_passes.position_sizing: 100% available cash including entry fee; fractional quantity; no lot-size or liquidity claim
risk_notes: Intrabar execution and ROI minute transitions cannot be exactly recovered from 12h OHLCV
Current finality, PIT universe, capacity and release-time data are not established
execution_if_gate_passes.roi_clock: elapsed wall-clock minutes from actual executed entry timestamp; at intrabar step transitions price availability unknown so activate threshold only at next executable bar open, label proxy
execution_if_gate_passes.signals_nan: no indicator mutation beyond exact original pipeline; invalid predicate means false; entry and exit both true means no new position
execution_if_gate_passes.termination: force-liquidate on last bar close before end exclusive; charge exit costs; include trade reason
execution_if_gate_passes.trailing_rule: activate after observed favorable close return reaches 0.2684; stop at favorable maximum close*(1-0.22673), only next bar active; initial risk stop entry*(1-0.34549), never loosen; label end-of-bar proxy rather than silent Freqtrade reproduction
execution_if_gate_passes.universe: predeclared BTCUSDT spot, one long position, max_open_trades=1; not full author universe

feature_columns: all columns generated by exact ta 0.11.0 add_all_ta_features(fillna=True)
gate: Any proven future dependence in original full pipeline blocks original implementation. No silently narrowed feature set, no fillna change, no repair, no backtest metrics generated. Report if dependence is restricted to warmup and distinguish decision predicates.
historical_exposure: Same BTCUSDT 2023-2024 price window used in earlier catalog diagnostics; not untouched OOS; author search count unknown
prefix_comparison: Compare every overlapping output row/feature to full 1524-row computation; exact and 1e-12 relative/absolute numerical differences reported; no return computation
